messages.author: eb840b2d1f31deb7
messages.subject: Why doesn't this work??
parts:
Hi, I am a total newbie to R and ggplot2. I have installed R version 2.15.0 on my Windows desktop as well as the ggplot2 package.

 

I am now working through Hadley Wickam’s gglpot2 (2009) book.  I have done the following:

 

>install.packages(“ggplot2”)       # installed OK

>set.seed(1410)                               # ggplot2, p.10, Wickam 2009  - OK

>dsamall <- diamonds[sample(nrow(diamonds),100,]   

> dsmall <- diamonds[sample(nrow(diamonds),100),]   # gglot2, p.11,2009  - Error!!

Error: object 'diamonds' not found

> dsmall <- ggplot2::diamonds[sample(nrow(diamonds),100),]  # I thought I would try this but this is no better.

Error in nrow(diamonds) : object 'diamonds' not found

 

Could the problem be that R version 2.15.0 is not a stable version or not tested with ggplot2 and should I install R version 2.14.x ??  Or is there some other problem??

 

 

John Edwards

messages.author: 5f8b51633aa2f2a1
messages.subject: Re: Why doesn't this work??
parts:
You also need to load ggplot2 once per R session with
library("ggplot2") -- you shouldn't need to repeat the install step
each time though.

Michael
